species.name: Crumband
dex_pages: It curls an ear @ into a handle @ for stolen crumbs.
The warm pocket @ beneath its rim @ bakes a new shell.
species.visual_theme: The first-stage spiral ear stretches into an asymmetrical C-shaped baked handle. A shallow open torso cup, one overflowing cookie, thick rim arms and stout feet replace the slender bandit imp.

species.name: Jarbaron
dex_pages: Its cookie hoard @ stays warm inside @ a thick baked rim.
An ear has grown @ into the handle @ over warm cookies.
species.visual_theme: The C-handle closes into a huge shoulder-to-shoulder arch above three large cookies. Its face forms the open pail rim; deep cookie crust and heavy crescent-cookie clamps replace the separate head and lid hat.
